sources.title: AI Autonomy: Self‐initiated Open‐world Continual Learning and ...
sources.snippet: This paper proposes a Self-initiated Open-world continual Learning and Adaptation (SOLA) framework to promote the research of autonomous AI agents so that they can face the real open world and learn by themselves. An example SOLA agent in the context of dialogue systems or chatbots that implements the SOLA framework is also discussed.
